t: Tech Talent Acquisition Business Partner (1 Year Fixed-Term Contract)
content: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact As our Talent Acquisition Business Partner, you'll own end-to-end hiring across our most important tech roles, from Application Engineering to Platform and beyond. You're the person making sure we hire the right people, fast. No hand-holding. No waiting. You see what needs to happen and you make it happen. This isn't a generalist role, but it does require range. You're an experienced tech recruiter who's comfortable across different areas of the tech landscape, and can easily context switch. You'll partner directly with Engineering stakeholders to shape hiring strategy, sharpen briefs, and raise the bar on every search. You'll bring structure where it's missing, challenge assumptions that slow things down, and take ownership of projects that currently sit with leadership. You're the kind of person who spots a blocker on Monday and has it resolved by Tuesday. Tech hiring is what will make or break our growth, and you'll be the person who builds the foundation that makes it possible. Real ownership, real visibility, and a direct line to shaping Mollie's future. What you'll ship - Own end-to-end hiring for Engineering roles - from intake to offer - with the pace and precision our teams depend on - Build real partnerships with Engineering stakeholders, shaping how they approach hiring, not just executing on their requests - Bring structure and craft to tech intake, calibration, and pipeline planning, so every hiring decision reflects both immediate needs and where the team is headed - Spot the proc

What you'll ship - Office Maintenance: Conduct daily checks, restock snacks and kitchen supplies (~1 hour/day, with heavier clean-up and dishwasher duties on Tuesdays and Thursdays). Maintain plants and liaise with coffee suppliers. Ensure overall office cleanliness, meeting room readiness, and basic IT/wiring upkeep. - Supply Management: Manage office supplies and weekly grocery orders, including receiving and organising inventory. Liaise and manage external vendors and suppliers (groceries, coffee, catering, etc.) to ensure timely delivery and payment. - Facilities Support: Coordinate landlord communications and liaise with external service providers for cleaning, catering, maintenance, and ad-hoc facilities needs or events. Handle minor office repairs, IT/wiring setup, and room maintenance as needed. - Health and Safety: Helping to ensure a safe working environment you will form a part of a team that acts as first responders to any emergency, organise the yearly training and ensure that our Lisbon office is compliant with H&S legislation - Emergency Preparedness & Drills: Maintain the office Medidas de Autoproteção (Self-Protection Measures) and execute annual evacuation drills (with training provided). - Occupational Health & Ergonomics: Oversee ergonomic assessments and occupational health checks (Medicina do Trabalho) for all Portugal-based employees. - Compliance Documentation: Maintain all health, safety, and facilities documentation to ensure 100% compliance during ACT audits. - Hospitality & Events: Welcome guests and vendors to the office. Support ad-hoc office events, meet-ups, and social committee initiatives, with potential to lead future social and team-building events. Support with event catering, possibility of supporting lunch in the future. - Policy Enforcement: Encourage a culture of shared responsibility for the office environment by firmly but respectfully providing feedback to colleagues on clearing up after themselves. - Office support: You will assist with welcom

Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You’ll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you’re aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you’ll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy If you're excited by the idea of building what’s next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we’d love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below. Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie https://jobs.mollie.com/ is really like. Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you’ll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver. If you’re ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you. Your impact The Infrastructure Governance team within the developer enablement domain sits at the heart of Mollie's infrastructure. We own and maintain Terraform as our IaC system and play a crucial role in ensuring our infrastructure is highly reliable and compliant with industry standards like PCI-DSS, sitting directly in the critical payment path and communication layer between external works and our platform. We also manage critical components that support all of Mollie’s infrastructure. That means what we build and maintain isn't just technical infrastructure; it's the foundation that keeps payments moving safely and reliably for hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe. As a Platform Engineer on this team, you'll be working on Mollie's Cloud Platform (MCP), our flavour of GCP, enabling product teams to create real value. Your work will span critical cloud infrastructure, automation, observability, and system reliability. You'll collaborate closely with system and software engineers, and interface with teams across compute, database engineering, edge, and networking. The impact is immediate and tangible: the systems you build and maintain keep Mollie's payments running. This is a role for someone who cares about quality for engineers and non-engineers alike and who brings a genuine passion for automation, distributed systems, and getting things right at scale.
